title: 2022 HMMT November Guts Problem 13
statement:
Consider the paths from \((0,0)\) to \((6,3)\) that only take steps of unit length up and right. Compute the sum of the areas bounded by the path, the \(x\)-axis, and the line \(x=6\) over all such paths.
(In particular, the path from \((0,0)\) to \((6,0)\) to \((6,3)\) corresponds to an area of 0 .)

solutions.text: We see that the sum of the areas under the path is equal the sum of the areas above the path. Thus, the sum of the areas under the path is half the area of the rectangle times the number of paths, which is \(\frac{18\binom{9}{3}}{2}=756\).
